importantNotes: Input feature order must always be MQ7 followed by MQ135.
Inputs are dataset sensor readings, not calibrated ppm values.
The model does not calculate calibrated carbon-monoxide concentration.
Readings outside the training ranges should be treated as out-of-distribution.
The model requires validation using the final physical MQ7 and MQ135 sensors.
limitations: Perfume is sometimes confused with NoGas.
The dataset hardware may differ from the final prototype hardware.
This model must not be treated as a certified industrial safety system.
Rule-based local alarms should remain available independently of the model.
